description: Section headings the reader shows above a paragraph, keyed by the record that opens it. They are editorial aids, not translation: they are not in the source, they are written from Open Word Bible's own wording, and they may use reader settings. Every heading is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

JOB.1.1.s1.en: Job, a blameless man in the land of Uz
JOB.1.1.s1.es: Job, un hombre intachable en la tierra de Uz
JOB.1.1.s1.fr: Job, un homme intègre au pays d’Outs
JOB.1.1.s1.pt: Jó, um homem íntegro na terra de Uz

JOB.1.6.s1.en: Does Job fear God for nothing?
JOB.1.6.s1.fr: Est-ce pour rien que Job craint Dieu ?
JOB.1.6.s1.pt: É por nada que Jó teme a Deus?

JOB.2.1.s1.en: Job is struck in his own body
JOB.2.1.s1.es: Job es herido en su propio cuerpo
JOB.2.1.s1.fr: Job est frappé dans son propre corps
JOB.2.1.s1.pt: Jó é ferido no próprio corpo

JOB.2.11.s1.en: Three friends come to comfort Job
JOB.2.11.s1.es: Tres amigos vienen a consolar a Job

JOB.3.1.s1.en: Job curses the day he was born
JOB.3.1.s1.es: Job maldice el día en que nació
JOB.3.1.s1.fr: Job maudit le jour de sa naissance
JOB.3.1.s1.pt: Jó amaldiçoa o dia em que nasceu

JOB.4.1.s1.en: Eliphaz answers: who that was innocent ever perished?
JOB.4.1.s1.fr: Éliphaz répond : quel innocent a jamais péri ?
JOB.4.1.s1.pt: Elifaz responde: que inocente já pereceu?

JOB.5.1.s1.en: Eliphaz: no one will answer you

JOB.6.1.s1.en: Job: if only my anguish could be weighed
JOB.6.1.s1.es: Job: si se pudiera pesar mi angustia
JOB.6.1.s1.fr: Job : si l’on pouvait peser ma détresse
JOB.6.1.s1.pt: Jó: se a minha angústia pudesse ser pesada

JOB.7.1.s1.pt: Os meus dias não têm esperança

JOB.9.1.s1.en: Job answers: how can a mortal be in the right with God?
JOB.9.1.s1.es: Responde Job: ¿cómo puede un mortal tener razón ante Dios?
JOB.9.1.s1.fr: Job répond : comment un mortel serait-il juste devant Dieu ?
JOB.9.1.s1.pt: Jó responde: como pode um mortal ter razão diante de Deus?

JOB.10.1.s1.en: I will speak in the bitterness of my soul
JOB.10.1.s1.fr: Je parlerai dans l’amertume de mon âme
JOB.10.1.s1.pt: Falarei na amargura da minha alma

JOB.11.1.s1.en: Zophar: God's wisdom is beyond your reach
JOB.11.1.s1.es: Zofar: la sabiduría de Dios está fuera de tu alcance
JOB.11.1.s1.fr: Tsophar : la sagesse de Dieu te dépasse
JOB.11.1.s1.pt: Zofar: a sabedoria de Deus está fora do seu alcance

JOB.12.1.s1.en: Job answers: I am not inferior to you
JOB.12.1.s1.es: Responde Job: no soy inferior a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}
JOB.12.1.s1.fr: Job répond : je ne vous suis pas inférieur
JOB.12.1.s1.pt: Jó responde: não sou inferior a vocês

JOB.13.1.s1.en: Job wants to argue his case with God
JOB.13.1.s1.es: Job quiere defender su causa ante Dios
JOB.13.1.s1.fr: Job veut plaider sa cause devant Dieu
JOB.13.1.s1.pt: Jó quer defender a sua causa diante de Deus

JOB.14.1.s1.en: A short life, full of trouble
JOB.14.1.s1.es: Una vida breve y llena de aflicción
JOB.14.1.s1.fr: Une vie courte et pleine de tourments
JOB.14.1.s1.pt: Uma vida curta e cheia de aflição

JOB.15.1.s1.en: Eliphaz answers: windy words and a guilty mouth
JOB.15.1.s1.es: Responde Elifaz: palabras de viento y una boca culpable
JOB.15.1.s1.fr: Éliphaz répond : des paroles de vent et une bouche coupable
JOB.15.1.s1.pt: Elifaz responde: palavras de vento e uma boca culpada

JOB.17.1.s1.en: My spirit is broken, my days are snuffed out
JOB.17.1.s1.es: Mi espíritu está quebrantado, mis días se apagan
JOB.17.1.s1.fr: Mon esprit est brisé, mes jours s’éteignent
JOB.17.1.s1.pt: O meu espírito está quebrantado, os meus dias se apagam

JOB.18.1.s1.en: Bildad: the light of the wicked goes out
JOB.18.1.s1.es: Bildad: la luz del malvado se apaga
JOB.18.1.s1.fr: Bildad : la lumière du méchant s’éteint
JOB.18.1.s1.pt: Bildad: a luz do ímpio se apaga

JOB.19.1.s1.en: Job: it is God who has wronged me
JOB.19.1.s1.es: Job: es Dios quien me ha hecho daño
JOB.19.1.s1.fr: Job : c’est Dieu qui m’a fait du tort
JOB.19.1.s1.pt: Jó: foi Deus quem me fez injustiça

JOB.20.1.s1.en: The joy of the godless lasts only a moment
JOB.20.1.s1.es: La alegría del impío dura solo un momento
JOB.20.1.s1.fr: La joie de l’impie ne dure qu’un instant
JOB.20.1.s1.pt: A alegria do ímpio dura só um momento

JOB.22.1.s1.en: Eliphaz: is not your evil great?
JOB.22.1.s1.fr: Éliphaz : ta méchanceté n’est-elle pas grande ?
JOB.22.1.s1.pt: Elifaz: não é grande a sua maldade?

JOB.23.1.s1.en: Job: if only I knew where to find him
JOB.23.1.s1.fr: Job : si je savais où {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} trouver
JOB.23.1.s1.pt: Jó: se eu soubesse onde encontrá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}

JOB.24.1.s1.en: Why does the Almighty not set times for judgment?
JOB.24.1.s1.es: ¿Por qué el Todopoderoso no fija tiempos para el juicio?
JOB.24.1.s1.fr: Pourquoi le Tout-Puissant ne fixe-t-il pas des temps pour juger ?
JOB.24.1.s1.pt: Por que o Todo-Poderoso não marca tempos para o juízo?

JOB.25.1.s1.en: How can a mortal be righteous before God?
JOB.25.1.s1.es: ¿Cómo puede un mortal ser justo ante Dios?
JOB.25.1.s1.fr: Comment un mortel serait-il juste devant Dieu ?
JOB.25.1.s1.pt: Como pode um mortal ser justo diante de Deus?

JOB.26.1.s1.en: How you have helped the powerless!
JOB.26.1.s1.fr: Comme tu as bien aidé le faible !

JOB.27.1.s1.en: Job holds fast to his integrity
JOB.27.1.s1.es: Job se aferra a su integridad
JOB.27.1.s1.pt: Jó se apega à sua integridade

JOB.28.1.s1.en: There is a mine for silver
JOB.28.1.s1.fr: Il y a une mine pour l’argent
JOB.28.1.s1.pt: Há uma mina para a prata

JOB.28.12.s1.en: But where can wisdom be found?
JOB.28.12.s1.pt: Mas onde se acha a sabedoria?

JOB.28.20.s1.en: God understands the way to wisdom
JOB.28.20.s1.es: Dios entiende el camino de la sabiduría
JOB.28.20.s1.fr: Dieu comprend le chemin de la sagesse
JOB.28.20.s1.pt: Deus entende o caminho da sabedoria

JOB.29.1.s1.en: Job remembers the days when God watched over him
JOB.29.1.s1.es: Job recuerda los días en que Dios lo cuidaba
JOB.29.1.s1.fr: Job se souvient des jours où Dieu veillait sur lui
JOB.29.1.s1.pt: Jó se lembra dos dias em que Deus cuidava dele

JOB.30.1.s1.en: But now they laugh at me
JOB.30.1.s1.es: Pero ahora se ríen de mí
JOB.30.1.s1.fr: Mais maintenant ils se moquent de moi

JOB.31.1.s1.pt: Uma aliança com os meus olhos

JOB.34.1.s1.en: Elihu calls the wise to judge Job's words
JOB.34.1.s1.es: Eliú llama a los sabios a juzgar las palabras de Job
JOB.34.1.s1.fr: Élihou appelle les sages à juger les paroles de Job
JOB.34.1.s1.pt: Eliú chama os sábios para julgar as palavras de Jó

JOB.35.1.s1.en: What do you give to God?
JOB.35.1.s1.pt: O que você dá a Deus?

JOB.36.1.s1.en: Elihu speaks for God once more
JOB.36.1.s1.es: Eliú habla otra vez en favor de Dios
JOB.36.1.s1.fr: Élihou parle encore en faveur de Dieu
JOB.36.1.s1.pt: Eliú fala outra vez a favor de Deus

JOB.38.1.s1.en: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} answers Job from the storm
JOB.38.1.s1.es: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} responde a Job desde la tormenta
JOB.38.1.s1.fr: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} répond à Job du milieu de la tempête
JOB.38.1.s1.pt: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} responde a Jó do meio da tempestade

JOB.39.1.s1.en: Do you know when the mountain goats give birth?
JOB.39.1.s1.fr: Sais-tu quand mettent bas les chèvres des montagnes ?
JOB.39.1.s1.pt: Sabes quando as cabras monteses dão à luz?

JOB.40.6.s1.en: Will you condemn me so that you may be in the right?

JOB.41.1.s1.en: No one can stand before Leviathan
JOB.41.1.s1.fr: Nul ne peut tenir devant le Léviathan

JOB.42.7.s1.es: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reprende a los amigos de Job
JOB.42.7.s1.fr: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} reprend les amis de Job
JOB.42.7.s1.pt: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} repreende os amigos de Jó

JOB.42.12.s1.en: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} blesses the latter days of Job
JOB.42.12.s1.es: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} bendice los últimos días de Job
JOB.42.12.s1.fr: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} bénit les derniers jours de Job
JOB.42.12.s1.pt: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} abençoa os últimos dias de Jó
